## Ronald Wong

### Tenure

### Title

Lead Product Designer, Premium

### Signature

[![RonaldWongSig](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/4/47/RonaldWongSig.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/150?cb=20251029175321)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/4/47/RonaldWongSig.png/revision/latest?cb=20251029175321)

**Ronald Wong** is a Hong Kong Hot Wheels designer who has worked with Mattel since 2014, initially as an intern before joining Mattel full-time as a Product Designer; he currently manages the [Hot Wheels Premium](/wiki/Hot_Wheels_Premium) line. He is noted to prioritize track performance for his designs; many of his designs are noted to be of high-end exotic cars. In addition to cars, he has designed a number of larger-scale vehicles and track sets. In addition to his design work at Mattel, Wong is also a photographer, photographing Hong Kong's car culture; he is also a collector of Hot Wheels and other larger scale diecast models, having maintained a collection since his childhood. He can be found under the internet handle ronalderw.
